headline: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑今日热度榜
headlineEn: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leads Today's Buzz
summary: 今日院线零新片，本周累计3部新片上映。热搜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《超级少女》《奥德赛》领跑，超级英雄与神话IP持续霸榜；下周《The Last Sunrise》等新作蓄势待发。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today, with three new releases this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Supergirl, and The Odyssey lead the trending chart, as superhero and mythic IPs dominate; next week's The Last Sunrise and others are on deck.

industryHighlights.text: 本周仅3部新片上映，市场进入暑期中段调整期。
industryHighlights.en: Only three new films opened this week, as the summer box office enters a mid-season adjustment.

industryHighlights.text: 《后室》《宇宙巨人：希曼崛起》跻身周榜，热门IP衍生作关注度上升。
industryHighlights.en: The Backrooms and Masters of the Universe: He-Man Rising entered the weekly chart, signaling rising interest in IP adaptations.

industryHighlights.text: 《The Last Sunrise》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》列入待映，后续排片值得关注。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming titles include The Last Sunrise, OK Boss Lady 2, and Escape from Dead End Street, all worth watching.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零上映新片，热搜被头部大片长期占据。
industryHighlights.en: With zero releases today, the trending list remains dominated by major tentpole titles.
